plan: OpenVibe Updated Plan Based On Codebase (T16, owner decision 2026-10-08: Codes is the open coding-agent harness; the developer console moved to OpenVibe.Services)
summary: Public at https://openvibe.codes (sudo ovhost deploy codes; unit openvibe-codes on 127.0.0.1:4900). Since 2026-10-08 Codes is the open coding-agent harness: openvibe-codes (a command-line tool and Node.js module, v0.2.0) runs a coding task on Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Command Code, Aider, the DeepSeek API or a person's own OpenAI-compatible model on their machine, hands it to the next agent when one fails or goes quiet, and keeps every run; the site carries the agent catalog with a public routing API, getting started, Improve OpenVibe and the community documents. The developer console that used to live here moved to OpenVibe.Services (https://openvibe.services) and every one of its addresses answers a permanent redirect there.
works: openvibe-codes on a person's machine (bin/openvibe-codes.js, harness/): agents, route, run, runs, show, resume; installs from the release tag

Adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Command Code and Aider (their CLIs) and for the DeepSeek API and any OpenAI-compatible server (the harness's own agent loop with list/read/grep/write/edit/run tools, confined to the working directory)
One event stream for every agent, in Claude Code's stream-json shape, ending with exactly one result; keys and tokens redacted
Hand-offs: a failed, rate-limited, crashed or silent attempt hands the task to the next routed agent with a note (task, tools, files changed, last message, git status)
Permission levels read / edit / full mapped onto each agent's own sandbox or tool set
Runs kept on the person's machine (OPENVIBE_CODES_HOME, files 0600) for show and resume
Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (authorization code + PKCE S256), session tokens in httpOnly cookies
The agent catalog (server/data/harness-offers.json, validated at boot as platform.harness-offer@1 / platform.agent-offer@1): /harnesses and GET /api/v1/harnesses
Routing a task over the catalog with openvibe-sdk/placement: POST /api/v1/harnesses/route { task, requirements? } → { selected, reasons, candidates } (the same router the command line uses)
Getting started (/start): install, the agents and what each needs, commands, permission levels, hand-offs, the event format, using it from code
Improve OpenVibe (/improve): every repository from the pinned contracts' service manifests, and the contributor path
The community documents (code of conduct, contributing, contributor ladder, moderation) rendered from this repository
Permanent redirects for every former console address (301 for reads, 308 for writes) to openvibe.services
robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and llms-full.txt; per-actor and per-address limits; truthful readiness
notYet: A hosted runner (tasks on OpenVibe.Run workers for people who do not run agents themselves) with budgets and metering
OpenVibe.Actor using Codes for its coding work
Improve OpenVibe as a guided run on this site (repository → change → tests → review → pull request); today it is the harness plus the contributor path on GitHub
The OpenVibe agent pool (~/openvibe/agents) running on this package instead of its own adapters
The community documents are drafts pending the owner's review
features: coding-agent harness (command line and Node.js module)
redirects for the moved developer console
